pass.description: true when every cell of `modules` is "pass", false when any is "fail".

reasoning.description: The two checklists the rubric asks for, and on a fail what it asks you to name. On a fail it is shown to the agent that wrote the modules.

modules.description: Your verdict on the two things judged, one entry for every <module> above marked changed="true" and for no other, keyed by its dir.

concern.description: 1: this module's concern is distinct from the concern of every other module.

home.description: 2: this module's home globs fit its concern.
